item.title: Cloud provider announces new GPU region
item.description: A cloud provider opened a new data centre region with GPU capacity aimed at AI workloads.

item.title: Customer support teams adopt AI agents with human handoff
item.description: Support organisations are deploying AI agents that use tool calling to look up orders and draft replies, while escalating refunds and edge cases to humans. Early results show faster first responses.

item.title: Smartphone sales dip in Q3
item.description: Global smartphone shipments fell slightly in the third quarter according to analysts.

item.title: Startups bundle workflow automation with AI consulting
item.description: A wave of small agencies now sell packaged automation: lead qualification, inbox triage and document processing, typically built on workflow tools plus LLM APIs.
